headline: Delhi: Two men arrested for murder over ‘affair’
author: TNN

body_text: NEW DELHI: Two men have been arrested for allegedly bludgeoning to death a 30-year-old man over suspicion of him having an extramarital affair . One of the accused is the victim’s brother-in-law who had hatched the conspiracy fearing that the man would soon leave his sister. The 24-year-old brotherin-law is Monu while the other accused, Ankit Rajput (23), worked in the victim’s jeans factory and is Monu’s friend. On January 2, police received a call about a man, Rajesh, having been brought dead to JPC Hospital with head injuries. DCP (northeast) Ved Prakash Surya said analysis of Rajesh’s call detail records and CCTV camera footage revealed suspicious movement of Rajput. He was apprehended for questioning and confessed to have killed Rajesh by hitting him with a gas cylinder on the head at the behest of Monu, Surya said. Monu, who was also arrested, said that on January 1, he was drinking with Rajesh and his employees inside the factory and told Rajput about his suspicion. “On this, the two men made the plan and when everyone else left the factory late in the night, Rajput hit Rajesh on his head twice with the gas cylinder,” said Surya. After making sure that Rajesh had died, they left the body inside the factory and fled the spot, the DCP said.
